hooks.command: bash -c 'LOCK_DIR=".lattice/commit.lock"; if [ -d "$LOCK_DIR" ]; then LOCK_META=""; if [ -f "$LOCK_DIR/meta" ]; then LOCK_META=$(cat "$LOCK_DIR/meta"); fi; LOCK_AGE=0; if [ -f "$LOCK_DIR/meta" ]; then LOCK_TIME=$(stat -c %Y "$LOCK_DIR/meta" 2>/dev/null || stat -f %m "$LOCK_DIR/meta" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); NOW=$(date +%s); LOCK_AGE=$((NOW - LOCK_TIME)); fi; echo "BLOCKED: commit lock is held."; echo "  Holder:"; echo "$LOCK_META" | sed "s/^/    /"; echo "  Age: ${LOCK_AGE}s"; echo ""; echo "If another session is committing, wait."; echo "If the lock is orphaned, recover with: bash scripts/release-lock.sh --force"; echo ""; echo "(Pre-2026-05-04 this hook silently force-cleared stale locks at 300s. Audit"; echo " CRITICAL-3/HIGH-1: that auto-clear destroyed legitimate long-running locks"; echo " -- e.g. a 6-minute peer-review pass -- and was a contributing factor to the"; echo " data-loss incident. Now: block + report, manual recovery only.)"; exit 1; fi'
hooks._comment: Commit lock. BLOCKS unconditionally if .lattice/commit.lock is held. Manual recovery for orphans (no auto-clear -- HIGH-1 fix 2026-05-04).

hooks.command: bash -c 'staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); changed=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null); all="$staged $changed"; HAS_RESEARCH=false; if echo "$all" | grep -qE "(research/[^/]+\.md|incoming/.*synthesis|peer-reviews/)"; then HAS_RESEARCH=true; fi; if [ "$HAS_RESEARCH" = true ]; then HAS_GAPS=false; if echo "$staged" | grep -qE "(REGISTRY\.md|TODO\.md)"; then HAS_GAPS=true; fi; if [ "$HAS_GAPS" = false ]; then echo "WARNING: Research/synthesis/review files changed but REGISTRY.md and TODO.md are not staged."; echo ""; echo "Did you persist discovered gaps? Every skill that discovers gaps must write them to:"; echo "  - docs/_internal/research/REGISTRY.md (research gaps)"; echo "  - docs/_internal/TODO.md (data/implementation gaps)"; echo ""; echo "If no gaps were found, this is OK -- proceed with the commit."; fi; fi'
hooks._comment: Gap persistence reminder. WARNS (non-blocking) when research/synthesis files changed but gap files not staged.

hooks.command: bash -c 'staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if echo "$staged" | grep -qE "PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN"; then if ! echo "$staged" | grep -qE "\.(test|spec)\."; then echo "PIPELINE MODULE CHANGED WITHOUT TESTS. Staged pipeline files:"; echo "$staged" | grep -E "PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN"; echo ""; echo "Commit checklist requires: write the failing test FIRST for these modules."; echo "Stage a test file, or use git commit with --no-verify if you have a reason."; exit 1; fi; fi'
hooks._comment: Pipeline test-first. BLOCKS if pipeline modules staged without test files. Replace PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN.

hooks.command: bash -c 'REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/.lattice/engine-changed" ]; then if [ ! -f "$REPO_ROOT/.lattice/validation-compared" ]; then echo "ENGINE FILES WERE MODIFIED but validation ratchet was not run."; echo ""; echo "Run: bash scripts/validation-ratchet.sh auto"; echo ""; echo "This ensures analytical behavior changes are detected and documented."; exit 1; fi; fi'
hooks._comment: Validation ratchet. BLOCKS if engine files changed without running ratchet.

hooks.command: bash -c 'REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$REPO_ROOT" ] && [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/context-meter.sh" ]; then bash "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/context-meter.sh"; fi'
bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "Co-Authored-By"; then echo "BLOCKED: CLAUDE.md rule 5 -- never add Claude as co-author."; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oP '"file_path"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+' 2>/dev/null || echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$REPO_ROOT" ] && [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/complexity-check.sh" ]; then bash "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/complexity-check.sh" "$FILE"; fi; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oP '"file_path"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+' 2>/dev/null || true); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "ENGINE_FILES_PATTERN"; then REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); mkdir -p "$REPO_ROOT/.lattice"; touch "$REPO_ROOT/.lattice/engine-changed"; rm -f "$REPO_ROOT/.lattice/validation-compared" 2>/dev/null; echo "ENGINE FILE MODIFIED: $(basename $FILE)"; echo "Validation ratchet will be required before commit."; fi'
hooks._comment: Engine change detection. Sets marker consumed by pre-commit hook. Replace ENGINE_FILES_PATTERN.

_setup._comment: Customize these patterns for your project:
_setup.PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN: Regex for data pipeline modules that require test-first discipline
_setup.ENGINE_FILES_PATTERN: Regex for engine/analytical files that require validation ratchet
